notes:
- Quality checker: every short-form clip is now checked three times before you get it back. Each check covers all 13 parts of the edit: cuts, camera, wides, B-roll, captions, hook, format, text motion, music, sound, picture, the whole clip, and the other clips in the project. The first check is quick, the second goes twice as deep, the third five times as deep, frame by frame. Problems are fixed between checks and the clip is made again. You only see “Checking the edit” while it works.
- Cuts are placed on the actual sound, so words are no longer clipped or dropped at a cut. Stutters, false starts and openings that start mid-sentence or on the host's question are cut again. A clip that doesn't end on a finished thought is fixed instead of shipped.
- Two clips from the same project no longer open on the same moment.
- Text stays off the video's own text: Revive's hook and captions no longer sit on a question card or its Reply bar. The faces and contrast checks run again; they had silently stopped working.
- Your B-roll only goes into your own story. When the person talking is someone else, such as a guest on a podcast you post, your B-roll of yourself is no longer cut in. New B-roll clips are also checked for talking shots (someone speaking into a microphone or on a podcast set), which are never used as cutaways.
- Misheard names and brands in captions are corrected, for example “TikTok shots” becomes “TikTok Shop's”.
